description: This file defines the StaticMap class, a Drupal migration process plugin that maps source values to destination values using a static associative array, with options for bypassing, default values, and handling various data types.

classes.name: StaticMap
classes.description: A Drupal migration process plugin class that performs static value mapping based on configuration.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the input value based on a static mapping array, handling NULLs, arrays, defaults, and bypass options.
